176-2921-4875.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-2921-4875.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat.

2301-4279-4616--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4279-4616--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

141-3085-5147.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3085-5147.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4772-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

4986-5231-7896--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Mirkwood Nurturer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mirkwood Nurturer enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Mirkwood Nurturer
Repeat.
4986-5231-7896--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

6441-7824-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer and Bard.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
6441-7824-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

573-1993-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
573-1993-7857.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more counters on it

1912-4050-5523-7218.description:
Activate Reaping Willow by paying {W/B} due to Biomancer's Familiar and removing two counters from it, returning Defiant Greatmaw from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters, it triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on Reaping Willow.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw, adding {W/B}.
Repeat.

423-433-1437-3756--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-433-1437-3756--85.description:
Cast Llanowar Scout by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Llanowar Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Llanowar Scout copy.
Activate the Llanowar Scout token by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-5921-5970-7296.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2438-2781-3817.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

856-1379-5315-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

6620-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.

270-1987-4311-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Hedron Archive.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1429-2921-4875-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2921-4875-5402.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1846-3546-3783-4300-5361.notablePrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
1846-3546-3783-4300-5361.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the tapped Island from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate High Market's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion.
When the Illusion dies, Auton Soldier and Minn's second abilities trigger.
Holding priority, activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning High Market from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Resolve the Auton Soldier and Minn triggers, putting an Island and High Market from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-1232-4885-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-4885-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

174-877-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

364-1987-2493-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.
